name: OpenCode Go Usage
author: Chris Rueber
description: OpenCode Go allowance in the Omarchy bar: a custom OpenCode mark with meters for the 5-hour session, weekly, and monthly limits, plus a popup with percentages, reset countdowns, and local activity.

barWidget.description: Bar pill with the OpenCode mark and three limit meters; click for percentages, reset times, Console budgets, and local activity.

schema.label: Bar shows
schema.description: bars: the mark plus one meter per limit; text: percentages instead of meters; icon: just the mark.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask for fresh limits. Five minutes is the default; the widget also keeps a disk cache so shell restarts do not cause extra requests.

schema.label: Warning threshold (%)
schema.description: Meters turn the warning colour at this percentage.

schema.label: Critical threshold (%)
schema.description: Meters turn the urgent colour at this percentage.

schema.label: Warning colour
schema.description: Hex colour; empty keeps the theme foreground.

schema.label: Critical colour
schema.description: Hex colour; empty uses the theme's urgent colour.

schema.label: opencode executable
schema.description: Optional. Path to the opencode binary; empty finds opencode in your login shell PATH.

schema.label: Show local activity in the popup
schema.description: Adds prompts, sessions, tokens, and estimated cost from your local OpenCode history (last 30 days).

schema.label: Right-click command
schema.description: Optional shell command; empty opens your OpenCode Console usage page.
